I'm Nathacia, a recent M.S. Business Analytics graduate from UC Irvine's Paul Merage School of Business. I'm based in Irvine, CA, and looking at roles in Orange County and San Diego. I also have a B.S. in Finance and Business Analytics from the University of San Francisco.

I like turning messy data into clear recommendations. My background spans internal auditing, financial analysis, and a few analytics capstones, and I work mostly in Python, SQL, R, and Tableau.

I'm looking for data analyst and business analyst roles. The projects on this site show how I work, so feel free to look around and get in touch.
